biggest_catch: Your friend must qualify and complete all activity — new member, open a Spend Plus or Spend Free checking account, and make 10 debit card purchases of $5+ within 60 days — and you earn a maximum of 5 rewards ($500) per calendar year.
catches: Friend must be a new member (not a member in the last 12 months)
Friend must open a Spend Plus or Spend Free checking account and make 10 debit card purchases of at least $5 each within the first 60 days
Referrer can receive a maximum of 5 referral rewards per calendar year ($500)
Rewards scheduled to be paid on day 63 after account opening; delays may affect the actual date
Referrer must be the Primary Account Holder on at least one active WECU deposit account
Both Referrer and Friend must have an email on file with WECU; taxes apply

c1.evidence: Official WECU Terms & Conditions PDF (wecu.com): 'By making a valid referral, Referrer will receive $100 and Friend will receive $50.'

c2.evidence: Official terms hosted on WECU's own domain (wecu.com), PDF revised 04/2025, fetched live 2026-09-23; program offered at offers.wecu.com/referchecking

c3.evidence: 'You must be a legal resident of the United States of America and at least 18 years old'; employees, youth-account-only members, self-referrals, and fictitious accounts excluded

c4.evidence: Valid referral requires Friend to (i) qualify for membership, (ii) open a Spend Plus or Spend Free checking product, and (iii) make ten (10) debit card purchases of $5+ within the first 60 days

eligibility: Referrer must be a WECU member, at least 18, a US legal resident, Primary Account Holder on at least one active WECU deposit account, with an email on file. Friend must be a new member (no membership in the last 12 months), 18+, with an email on file, and must open a Spend Plus or Spend Free checking account.
notes: WECU = Whatcom Educational Credit Union (Bellingham, WA). Official refer-checking terms and conditions PDF on wecu.com (revised 04/2025), fetched live 2026-09-23. No stated program expiration; treated as a standing offer subject to WECU's right to cancel.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($100 flat per qualifying referral to the referrer); time: referral share 5-15 min active
payout_quote: By making a valid referral, Referrer will receive $100 and Friend will receive $50. Referrer can earn a maximum of 5 rewards per calendar year (maximum of $500).
payout_value_note: $100 cash deposited to the referrer per qualifying referral; maximum 5 referrals per calendar year ($500).

s1.note: Official WECU terms PDF live on wecu.com, fetched 2026-09-23

s2.note: Eligibility: member referrer 18+, US resident, Primary Account Holder on active deposit account; friend is a new member 18+

s3.note: Friend: new member, open Spend Plus or Spend Free checking, 10 debit card purchases of $5+ within 60 days

s4.note: Referral share; referrer shares a personal link, friend completes the referral as described

s5.note: Paid on day 63 after account opening into the referrer's longest active WECU checking account (or savings if no checking); no per-referral stated deadline beyond that

s6.note: Referrer and Friend are responsible for all federal, state and local taxes

s7.note: No cap beyond 5 referral rewards ($500) per calendar year; friends must be new members, no limit on number of friends invited

steps: Visit the referral site at https://offers.wecu.com/referchecking and follow the onscreen instructions to generate your personal referral link
Share the personal link with friends, family members, or colleagues (email on file required for both parties)
Your friend qualifies for WECU membership as a new member (not a member in the last 12 months) and applies through the referral
Your friend opens a Spend Plus or Spend Free checking account
Your friend makes ten (10) debit card purchases of at least $5 each within the first 60 days of account opening
The $100 reward is deposited into your longest active WECU checking account (or savings if you have no checking) around day 63
timing: Reward scheduled to be paid on day 63 after the referred account opening, once all qualifications are met.
